scope: Read-only source/log advisory; no builds, tests, native runs, owner ratification or performance acceptance. Only this /tmp advisory written.
disposition: No remaining identified blocker in reviewed bounded input/timer conformance delta. Matched baseline instrumentation and actual per-trial schedule/output/method predicates remain execution prerequisites; no acceptance or owner ratification.

findings.finding: Receipt complete predicate ignores validity/truncation of separately captured final state. Final hover can change through an unrecorded event after the last pointer/button and export complete:true with truncated final state.
findings.required: Capture final State once, include its validity in complete, retain failed artifact and error.

findings.finding: Input JSON allocation/serialization/write occurs before final_handoff closes common process/resource measurement window. Post-workload observer export cost and temporary memory contaminate endpoint interval unless separately bounded/labeled.
findings.required: Close accounting endpoint before serialization (e.g. final_handoff acknowledgement then export while runtime remains live), and require successful export as a separate trial-validity predicate. Do not promote export-inflated endpoint interval into workload CPU duty.

findings.finding: Only final cursor is checked; post-last-pointer camera, epoch, native cursor, pan, hover, selection or focus changes can pass current consumer.
findings.required: Compare final snapshot invariants against last acknowledged state and selection/focus/pane against pinned workload expectations, in this helper or an explicit required runner predicate. Add changed-final-camera/epoch negative. No additional runtime instrumentation required.

observations: Preallocated bounded records preserve duplicate coordinates, event order, and completed dispatch across ordinary early returns. Overflow/nesting/missing after-state/truncated event state fail complete. No scheduling or DRM behavior introduced.

Route labels identify dispatch branches, not accepted semantic transitions. Consumer must validate expected route, state transitions, coalescing, final state and output; recorder complete alone is insufficient.
Only primary active camera and final selection/focus are captured. Restrict workload to pinned W-POINTER/W-PAN topology; do not infer arbitrary pane or terminal/action acknowledgement coverage.

Missing runtime at event entry currently silently skips begin; missing runtime at completion/export fails. If claiming loss-complete receipt for runtime-absent Main delivery, record explicit invalid state using Main window identity.

Timer checks detect exact moved-marker/omitted-marker mutations and suffix-only sample as designed, but lexical source assertions are not general control-flow or GPU scheduling proof. Keep exact source pins and manual source review; reuse actual GPU query/copy evidence.
Sample validator permits frame-only fallback appropriately; correlate actual graph classification if claiming prefix reuse for a frame. Validator has no received-input comparison yet.

Native test log reports 1 passing test with 3 injected native-dispatch motions, including repeated coordinate and no-crosshair cursor update. It does not prove X11 producer delivery or per-trial counts.

Equivalent baseline instrumentation, semantic/path/final-output validation, method interval reconciliation, and required timer control execution remain parent prerequisites; no trials authorized by this advisory.
